description: A linear strip of addressable NeoPixel-compatible RGB LEDs, with separate input-side and output-side power/ground pins for chaining.
how_to_use: VDD/VSS (input) and VDD.2/VSS.2 (output) are the same power/ground rail passed straight through for chaining to the next strip — same shape as a board's multiple same-net GND legs, so aliased together. DIN is data input (from the microcontroller or the previous strip's DOUT); DOUT passes the same bit-banged signal on to the next strip — not a shared bus, each link is its own independent connection.
